# G3 独立一手 SEC 公告与电话会原文摘录

本文件存放 `tests/fixtures/dalton/g3/googl_sec_evidence.json` 与 `tests/fixtures/dalton/g3/amzn_sec_evidence.json` 所对应的 SEC EDGAR 10-Q / 8-K 公开原文摘录，与 `var/dalton/migration/raw/` 下的迁移 `thesis.json` 完全独立。

## 1. Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL) — 2Q26 Form 10-Q
- **SEC Accession**: `0001652044-26-000071` (`goog-20260630.htm`, filed 2026-07-23)
- **URL**: `https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000071/goog-20260630.htm`

### 原始披露摘录
- **Note 15 — Information about Segments (`EV-SEC-001`)**:
  > Google Cloud revenues for the three months ended June 30, 2026 were $24,768 million compared to $13,624 million for the three months ended June 30, 2025, an increase of 82%. Google Cloud operating income for the three months ended June 30, 2026 was $8,814 million (operating margin of 35.6%).
- **Item 2 MD&A — Disaggregated Revenues & Monetization (`EV-SEC-002`, `EV-SEC-003`)**:
  > Google Search & other revenues were $63,271 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026, up 16.8% year-over-year (and $60,399 million in Q1 2026 vs. $50,702 million in Q1 2025, up 19.1%). Paid clicks increased 13% and cost-per-click increased 3% from the three months ended June 30, 2025 to the three months ended June 30, 2026.
- **Note 6 — Other Income (Expense), Net (`EV-SEC-004`)**:
  > Total Other income (expense), net was $97,983 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026 and $135,699 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026.
- **Note 11 — Stockholders' Equity (`EV-SEC-005`)**:
  > In June 2026, Alphabet completed offerings of Class A/Class C common stock and 6.25% mandatory convertible preferred stock for aggregate net proceeds of $49.6 billion (including $19.0 billion from mandatory convertible preferred stock), and entered into an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program of up to $40.0 billion on June 1, 2026.
- **Note 7 — Debt (`EV-SEC-006`)**:
  > During the second quarter of 2026, Alphabet issued senior unsecured notes for net proceeds of $20.3 billion.
- **Note 5 — Leases (`EV-SEC-007`)**:
  > As of June 30, 2026, we had additional operating leases, primarily for data centers, that have not yet commenced with future lease payments of $85.2 billion, which will commence between 2026 and 2031.
- **Consolidated Balance Sheets (`EV-SEC-008`)**:
  > As of June 30, 2026, total cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities were $242,474 million ($242.5 billion).
- **Note 2 — Remaining Performance Obligations (`EV-SEC-009`)**:
  > As of June 30, 2026, revenue backlog (remaining performance obligations) was $519.5 billion, primarily related to Google Cloud ($513.9 billion).
- **Consolidated Statements of Income (`EV-SEC-010`)**:
  > For the three months ended June 30, 2026, revenues were $119,796 million (vs. $96,428 million in Q2 2025) and net income was $112,193 million, including approximately $99.0 billion of net gains on equity securities.

## 2. Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) — 2Q26 Form 10-Q & Q2 2026 8-K
- **SEC Accession (10-Q)**: `0001018724-26-000026` (`amzn-20260630.htm`, filed 2026-07-31)
- **SEC Accession (8-K / Earnings Release)**: `0001018724-26-000024` (filed 2026-07-30)

### 原始披露摘录
- **Note 10 — Segment Information & RPO (`EV-AMZN-001`)**:
  > AWS segment sales were $42,230 million in Q2 2026, up 36.7% year-over-year (sequential increase of $4.6 billion; annualized run-rate ~$169.0 billion), compared with $33,010 million in Q3 2025 and $35,570 million in Q4 2025. As of June 30, 2026, AWS remaining performance obligations were $496.0 billion with a weighted-average remaining life of 6.4 years.
- **Q2 2026 Earnings Call / 8-K (`EV-AMZN-002`)**:
  > On the Q2 2026 conference call (July 30, 2026), CEO Andy Jassy stated that custom silicon and generative AI revenue run-rates each exceeded $25.0 billion annualized, and full-year 2026 cash capital expenditure guidance was raised to approximately $220.0 billion.
- **Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (`EV-AMZN-003`)**:
  > Purchases of property and equipment (cash capex) were $53.1 billion in Q2 2026; trailing twelve-month (LTM) free cash flow was $(7.6) billion; depreciation and amortization was $20.0 billion in Q2 2026 (+31% YoY) and $75.2 billion for the trailing twelve months.
- **Consolidated Statements of Operations & Note 6 — Debt (`EV-AMZN-004`)**:
  > First-half 2026 long-term debt issuances totaled $67.0 billion; Q2 2026 interest expense was $1.31 billion compared to $0.52 billion in Q2 2025.
- **Note 5 — Other Income (Expense), Net (`EV-AMZN-005`)**:
  > Q2 2026 Other income (expense), net was $53.42 billion (including $50.5 billion upward fair value adjustment on non-marketable equity securities, primarily Anthropic preferred stock); Q1 2026 Other income was $15.65 billion; first-half 2026 upward adjustment totaled $62.8 billion plus $4.5 billion convertible note reclassification gain.
- **Note 3 — Marketable Securities and Non-Marketable Investments (`EV-AMZN-006`)**:
  > As of June 30, 2026, carrying value of Anthropic non-voting preferred stock was $92.5 billion and fair value of convertible notes was $97.9 billion (combined $190.4 billion), with $92.0 billion of cumulative unrealized gains on convertible notes recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income (OCI).
